shared_opening: Count aloud from 1 to 30 as a class. Teacher points to each number on the board.
rotation: 10 min: teacher guides batch 1 with stones while batch 2 works on slate problems. Then swap: teacher checks batch 2 slates while batch 1 practices counting in pairs.
check_question: Ask 3 children: show me 7 stones. Show me 12 stones.

shared_opening: Teacher writes numbers 1-20 on board. Children read aloud together.
rotation: 10 min: teacher with batch 1 (matching numeral cards to groups of stones). 10 min: teacher with batch 2 (reading and writing two-digit numbers on slate).
check_question: Ask: what number comes after 15? Write 23 on your slate.

shared_opening: Skip count by 2s from 2 to 20. Clap on each number.
rotation: 15 min: batch 1 guided (counting objects in classroom). 15 min: batch 2 guided (ordering numbers on slate).
check_question: Give 5 children a number between 1 and 50 on paper. Ask them to stand in order smallest to largest.

shared_opening: Teacher draws 3 groups of objects on board. Children count and say which group has more.
rotation: 10 min: teacher with batch 1 (comparing groups of stones - more or fewer). 10 min: teacher with batch 2 (writing numbers in expanded form on slate).
check_question: Hold up two handfuls of stones. Which hand has more? How do you know?

shared_opening: Friday review: teacher says a number and children show it with fingers or stones.
rotation: Mixed practice day. 5 min each: counting race (batch 1) then number dictation (batch 2) then swap tasks.
check_question: Can you count backwards from 20 to 1? Write the number that is 10 more than 35.

shared_opening: Count aloud from 1 to 30 as a class. Teacher points to each number on the board.
rotation: 15 min: teacher guides batch 2 through place value of 5-digit numbers on board. Batch 1 practices writing numbers on slate independently.
check_question: Write 45203 in words. What is the place value of 5 in 45203?

shared_opening: Teacher writes numbers 1-20 on board. Children read aloud together.
rotation: 15 min: batch 2 reads and compares large numbers (teacher guided). Batch 1 does counting worksheet independently.
check_question: Which is bigger: 34567 or 34576? How did you decide?

shared_opening: Skip count by 2s from 2 to 20. Clap on each number.
rotation: 10 min: batch 2 works on ordering 5-digit numbers. 10 min: high group works on lakhs with teacher.
check_question: Arrange these numbers smallest to largest: 78234 and 87234 and 72834.

shared_opening: Teacher draws 3 groups of objects on board. Children count and say which group has more.
rotation: 15 min: batch 2 practices expanded form of large numbers. Batch 1 does independent counting activity.

shared_opening: Friday review: teacher says a number and children show it with fingers or stones.
rotation: Mixed review. Number dictation for batch 2 (large numbers). Batch 1 does number ordering game independently.
check_question: Read this number aloud: 93847. Now write the number I say: fifty-six thousand two hundred and nine.
